name: Los Angeles, CA
intro: City of Los Angeles public courts verified on the LA City Recreation and Parks website (recreation.parks.lacity.gov, also laparks.org) as of November 18, 2026. The city's pickleball page lists drop-in outdoor courts as first-come, first-served and asks players to call each facility for play times, so we have not listed hours it does not publish. Fee-based reservable courts, indoor programs, and LA County parks are not listed here yet. New to open play? Start with the national guides linked below, or browse all US cities.

venues.address: 8800 South Hoover St., Los Angeles, CA 90044
venues.open_play_times: Not published on the citywide list. The city says to call the facility for play times: (323) 753-5808.
venues.beginner_friendly_notes: The city lists this as a drop-in outdoor court: first-come, first-served, with play times available by calling the facility. The Algin Sutton Recreation Center page on the same official site also lists pickleball for this location.
venues.fees: Not published for drop-in play on the official pages we checked. Classes listed on the recreation center page are registered separately.
